name: 护主犬
evolution: 护主犬 → 音速犬 Lv.26 → 风暴战犬
description: 时刻保持着警觉，任何危险都无法逃过它的眼睛。虽然身形小巧，但面对无论多么凶猛庞大的敌人都会勇敢地燃起斗志。
descriptionEn: It stays alert at all times; no danger escapes its eyes. Though small in size, it bravely fires up its fighting spirit no matter how fierce or huge the enemy is.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; counters an attack.

skills.name: 火苗
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the user restores 1 energy.

skills.name: 引燃
skills.descriptionEn: The opponent gains 10 stacks of Burn.

skills.name: 流星火雨
skills.description: 造成物伤，每次击败敌方，本技能威力永久+75。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; each time it defeats an opponent, this skill's power is permanently +75.

skills.name: 当头棒喝
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，本次技能威力+100。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the opponent switches spirits this turn, this skill's power +100.

skills.name: 焚烧烙印
skills.description: 驱散双方所有印记，每驱散1层，敌方获得5层灼烧。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels all marks on both sides; for each stack dispelled, the opponent gains 5 stacks of Burn.

skills.name: 高温回火
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; the user withdraws.

skills.name: 怒火
skills.descriptionEn: The user gains both attacks +120% and both defenses -40%.

skills.name: 灼伤
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 热身
skills.description: 下一次攻击时，技能威力翻倍，应对防御：改为威力变为4倍。
skills.descriptionEn: On the next attack, the skill power is doubled; when countering a defense: instead the power becomes 4x.

skills.name: 火云车
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 闪燃
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为4倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when countering: this skill's power becomes 4x.
